independent_computation.step_1_amplifier_value: Unmake grants '12% increased magic damage'. As a percentage damage amplifier this is the multiplicative factor m_unmake = 1 + 12/100 = 1.12. The number 1.12 is arithmetically correct and is NOT stale: both the wiki branch text and the Riot description in the current cache read 12%.
step_2_gates_the_source_imposes: DAMAGE TYPE: the amplified quantity is 'magic damage'. Physical and true damage are outside the effect; the cached atom decomposition for 8020 carries damage.magic only.
TARGET CLASS: only 'enemy champions' become cursed — not minions, monsters, or allied units.
RANGE / HOLDER: the curse is an aura keyed on the Abyssal Mask holder ('within 700 units of you'), so it requires a living holder in range of the cursed enemy at the moment of the damage instance.
BENEFICIARY: 'from all sources' — once the gates above hold, the amp applies to any allied damage source in the roster, not just the holder's own damage.
independent_computation.step_3_composition_with_the_other_suppor: Imperial Mandate's Command marks Vulnerable: +7% from ALL sources for 4 s after an immobilize → m_mandate = 1.07, all damage types. Per data/wiki-atoms/damage.json, independent damage amplifiers compose multiplicatively, so the legal values of a support-granted damage multiplier in this scenario form a closed set: 1.12 (magic, cursed, Vulnerable inactive), 1.07 (any type, Vulnerable active, curse gate failed), 1.12 x 1.07 = 1.1984 (magic, cursed, Vulnerable active), or no multiplier at all (no support amp applies).

step_4_case_analysis_for_events[11].case_A_event_is_magic_damage_to_a_cursed: correct leaf = {"multiplier": 1.12, "source": "Abyssal Mask — Unmake"} → the OLD value.
step_4_case_analysis_for_events[11].case_B_event_is_physical_or_true_damage: Unmake does not touch it (magic-only). With no Mandate component present in the old leaf, Vulnerable was not active at this event either, so no support amplifier applies → the leaf is legitimately ABSENT (multiplier 1.0) → the NEW value.
step_4_case_analysis_for_events[11].case_C_target_not_a_cursed_enemy_champio: curse gate fails → leaf legitimately ABSENT → the NEW value.
step_4_case_analysis_for_events[11].excluded: 1.1984 (i.e. 'both_wrong' via a missing Mandate factor) is ruled out: the old leaf named Abyssal alone as its source, so Vulnerable was not active at event 11 under either baseline, and a Vulnerable factor cannot be introduced by this change.

independent_computation.step_5_selecting_the_case: The permitted evidence tree does not contain the scenario definition, so event 11's damage type is inferred rather than observed. Three considerations select case B/C over case A: (i) the leaf went fully ABSENT rather than changing numeric value — the signature of a gating fix ('emit the amp only where it legally applies'), not of a re-priced amplifier; (ii) the scenario name pairs the two support items whose defining difference is exactly the gate at issue (Mandate 7% all-sources vs. Abyssal 12% magic-only), so the discriminating assertion of the scenario is precisely that a non-magic event must NOT receive the 12%; (iii) a regression that dropped Unmake wholesale would have removed the leaf from every magic event in the ledger, which would make this scenario's headline totals, not a single mid-ledger leaf, the visible diff.
independent_computation.conclusion: 1.12 is the right magnitude for Unmake but is legal only on magic damage taken by a cursed enemy champion. Absent (no support amplifier) is the correct leaf for any event failing that gate. On the balance of the accessible evidence the removal at events[11] is the correct behavior.

confidence.pinned_with_certainty: Unmake = +12% (x1.12) magic damage only, 700-unit aura, enemy champions only, from all sources — quoted directly from the cache. A support_damage_multiplier of 1.12 on a non-magic event is unambiguously wrong.
confidence.residual_uncertainty: Event 11's damage type could not be read from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md. If events[11] is in fact magic damage dealt to a cursed enemy champion while the Abyssal holder is alive and in range, then the verdict inverts to old_value_correct. A reviewer with access to the scenario definition should confirm the damage type of combat event index 11 — that single fact decides this leaf.
